summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing of Fortu Estonian financial-literacy Expo/React Native app via web preview (390x844). All 13 requested feature groups verified end-to-end: login (Google/Apple mock sign-in), new-user home + why screen (5 rows), self-awareness flow (intro/instructions/5 questions with option-0..2, continue disabled until selection, selection changeable, hints without bottom-nav), back-navigation rules (Q→prev Q keeps answer, Q1→instructions, hint→its question, result→question 5), score-band lead on result (band 2 'palju häid harjumusi' verified when answering option 1 everywhere; band 3 'Oskad oma raha juhtida' verified when answering option 2) with no numeric score shown, 'Vaata oma vastuseid' / 'Peida vastused' toggle, ABC pack intro (RAHA LIIGUB) + 15 concepts with Kontrolli→Jätka state machine (locked options after check, Palgapäev correct answer in position 1 per kuvamisjarjekord), abc-done score ('5' + 'viieteistkümnest'), journey topic states (not-started → in-progress after self → completed after both; locks + Estonian reason strings 'Avaneb, kui rahatarkuse algus on läbitud' / 'Avaneb, kui eelmine teema on läbitud'), topic 2 start-button + 7-step plan + toast on Alusta ('Selle sammu sisu ei ole veel valmis.'), dictionary (17 entries, Estonian order: Sissetulek before Sääst, Võlg last; back from dict returns to exact /abc/q/3), profile empty state ('Profiili ei ole veel tehtud.'), returning home ('Tere taas!', continue card deep-links to /abc/q/3 '2. samm · Rahatarkuse ABC', 'Päevi koos Fortuga' = 14 hard-coded, 'Teemad läbitud' = 1 / 5), persistence (reload mid-ABC keeps state and signed-in user, resumes at /abc/q/3), bottom-nav visibility rules (visible on home/journey/dictionary/profile/question/result/topic/abc-intro; hidden on login/instructions/hints/pack-intros). No critical or minor bugs found; the app matches the specification. Only a non-blocking React Native deprecation warning observed in console.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking; stems from a library using the deprecated prop. Recommend auditing component tree for any pointerEvents prop and moving it to style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}. Reference: observed on all screens; main source likely in a transitive react-native-web dep.

test_report_links: Playwright scripts executed inline (not saved to disk) — flow covers login→self→abc→journey→dictionary→profile→home-returning→persistence
action_items: Investigate and silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning (likely in a third-party RN component or inside DeepBackground/ScreenShell wrapper).
critical_code_review_comments: State store is clean, uses functional updates, hydrates from AsyncStorage/localStorage behind progressRepository.
Mock authService correctly swap-able; no OAuth bleed.
ABC answer order rendering uses kuvamisjarjekord from sisu.json — verified in UI (Palgapäev correct option is 2nd/pos=1).
Topic-completion rule enforced in selectors.isTopicComplete; start-topic requires BOTH self + abc done.
Dictionary back navigation uses an in-memory dictFrom (session only) — works correctly for same-session scenarios.
seed_data_creation: None. Mock sign-in creates `demo-google` user; progress stored in localStorage key `fortu.progress.v1`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows pass. If retesting, remember: fresh browser session needs login first; use `[data-testid="self-result-toggle-answers"]` (not `self-result-toggle`); ABC uses `[data-testid="abc-question-button"]` for both Kontrolli and Jätka. Persistence works via localStorage key `fortu.progress.v1`.
